title: Features: a requirement is off
summary: DJDL's Settings → Features with Licensing and Sign-in off: Commerce's switch is disabled, its requirement shows a lock on Licensing and its status says Turn on Licensing first; Cloud Sync is disabled the same way because Sign-in is off (Managed config, its other requirement, keeps its tick); and the sidebar has no Licensing, Sign-in, Cloud Sync or Commerce group.
compare: The owner rule, drawn: a service can be turned on only when its requirements are on. Its switch is disabled (aria-disabled, still focusable) and its tooltip on hover says the same as the row: what to turn on first. The tooltip isn't drawn, so the words appear once.

The requirements mark each one: a tick for one that is on, a lock (bold) for one that is off ('Needs ✓ Managed config 🔒 Sign-in'); the status column holds the one next step ('Turn on Sign-in first'). Requirements come from tools/services.json.
Turn on Licensing / Turn on Sign-in scroll to and focus that row's switch; they don't turn anything on by themselves. The server refuses the dependent too (commerce_requires_license).
A feature that is off greys its name and tile and hides its own settings (Sign-in's Customer portal); a requirement that is off still says what needs it ('Needed by Commerce').
The sidebar shows groups only for features that are on.
Phone: the tooltip shows on long-press; the requirements and the link wrap under the description; switches are 44×24.

Brand v2 shell (lead B2–B5, 2026-10-09): the work sits on the inset canvas with a 3px rule in the page's context accent (full-bleed below 1024); one orientation line (context chip + crumbs, never 'Platform' on a product page, no eyebrow repeating the path); h1 36/44 on a collection, 32/40 on a record, 24/32 on a phone; the one filled primary is ink and selection is ink, the accent marks context only; the selected nav item is the subtle fill with a 3px marker; card heads are bands with no numerals; route tabs are an underline tablist with a 3px indicator; tables with filters are one workbench band; weights 400/500/600.

Masthead mark (B4): from 1024px a 48px flat tile on this page (the feature's glyph on a landing page, the product's icon on a product page) replaces the orientation chip; below 1024 the chip carries the context; never on a dense data page, a record or a state page.

findings.issue: Blocked toggles look like ordinary off toggles; stale 'Needed by Commerce'.
findings.resolution: Blocked switches are drawn at 50% with a not-allowed cursor; 'Needed by' removed; the unlock link is a meta line under the row.

findings.issue: Turn 'Turn on Sign-in first' into a button that turns on the prerequisite.
findings.resolution: declined: A behaviour change, not spacing or copy; the link already goes to the prerequisite.
